opponents.name: Ghost Sidewinder
opponents.special: The Ghost Sidewinder constantly produces confusing signals which confuse Gimballed and Turreted weapons. This effect is the same as a Chaff Launcher (Core Rules p.197), except that it consumes no ammo and does not need to be activated each turn.

opponents.name: Possessed Krait
opponents.special: If the Possessed Krait hits with both its Pulse Lasers, it also transmits a signal to the target ship which sends its controls haywire. The affected ship loses its next Combat Action.

opponents.name: Cyber-Cobra
opponents.special: If the Cyber-Cobra hits with both of its Pulse Lasers it transmits an override code into the target ship. The override code can do one of the following; jettison the ammo of all the target’s weapons, empty the target’s main fuel tank (one ton of fuel will remain in the emergency tank), jettison the cargo and escape pods of the target’s ship.

opponents.name: AspWinder
opponents.special: When destroyed, the AspWinder splits into two Ghost Sidewinders. Roll Initiative for these ships as normal.

opponents.name: Thargoid Invader
opponents.special: Thargoid Hearts 4. Impervious: its Hull (not its shields) can't be harmed by standard weapons, only by AX Missile Racks and AX Multi-cannons, and it is immune to critical hits. Shields only activate once a Heart has been exerted, then at full strength (800), and are vulnerable to normal weapons. Shutdown Field: its first action, instead of attacking; ships without a Shutdown Field Neutraliser lose all power until it moves away or is destroyed. Regeneration: as an Equipment action at the start of its turn it exerts a Heart to recover all damage and raise its shields (once). Hearts are impervious until detected by an AX Xeno Scanner and exerted; an exerted Heart has 100 Hull, shares the impervious trait and can be targeted like a component (also by fixed and turreted weapons). With no Hearts left it can't Regenerate. Each time it exerts a Heart it deploys a Thargon Swarm. Thargoid Disruptor: 80 Damage (40 vs Hull and components) and an automatic critical hit, even with the target's shields up. Caustic Missile (used between turns when a Heart is destroyed, two at once): +18 To Hit, 100 Damage, bypasses shields and inflicts three 50-Damage critical hits to components; Point Defence can intercept it.
